pairs.l: 1 — at first felt uncomfortable during their job?
2 — found it quite easy to change their work routine?
3 — followed the advice of a professional?
4 — says they depended on help from a partner?
9 — earned enough to return their debts?
11 — spent more money than they intended?
12 — wishes they had not chosen that line of work?

r1.exp: 1=A (Amelia: 'It felt quite AWKWARD at the time'). 2=B (Ben: 'felt COMFORTABLE WORKING FROM HOME from the very beginning'). 3=B (Ben: 'I attended a small course where I LEARNED NEW TECHNIQUES FROM AN EXPERT'). 4=D (David: 'I OWE A LOT TO MY FRIEND who was willing to invest'). 5=A (Amelia: 'successful job for a DROPOUT ARCHITECTURE STUDENT'). 6=F (Finley: 'too many clients so I had to TURN DOWN some of them, and DECIDING WHICH ONE WAS TOUGH'). 7=F (Finley: 'I have always loved animals and VOLUNTEERED at the local animal shelter'). 8=B (Ben: 'I was FED UP WITH COMMUTING... I left — factory turned out to be a failure'). 9=C (Candice: 'parents refused to TAKE BACK THE MONEY I HAD BORROWED'). 10=E (Edward: 'the TOOLS AND TECHNOLOGY for designing and printing, which I HAD TO PURCHASE'). 11=D (David: 'I DIDN'T THINK IT WAS GOING TO BE AS COSTLY AS IT WAS'). 12=E (Edward: 'IF ONLY I'D THOUGHT TWICE').

r13.exp: 'Scan and copy their brains... robots INDIVISIBLE FROM THE HUMANS' = takeover će se temeljiti na imitiranju/kopiranju = C.

r14.exp: 'Share some combination of GRATITUDE, EMPATHY AND AFFECTION for humans' = sposobni su osjećati za nas = B.

r15.exp: 'Spend their time DOING NOTHING MUCH AND STARING AT SCREENS' = imat će previše slobodnog vremena = D.

r16.exp: 'To make Ems possible, only three technologies need to coincide' (computers, brain scanning, modelling) — ne ovise o AI = A.

r17.exp: 'All predictions lead to the same place: THE DISAPPEARANCE OF HUMAN LABOUR' = svijet bez rada = A.

r18.exp: 'Everyone can enjoy leisure IF wealth is shared, OR most people can end up poor IF machine owners lobby against redistribution' = raspodjela bogatstva određuje korist = D.

r19.exp: 'Forced to turn to traditional and holistic techniques of relaxation. (19)____.' → E: SUCH TECHNIQUES ARE QUICKLY CATCHING UP ON THE FAST-MOVING MASSES.

r20.exp: 'Many scientists refuse to credit them. (20)____. THESE DAYS, classes in yoga are very popular.' → A: HOWEVER, IN RECENT YEARS, PEOPLE HAVE PROGRESSED A LOT IN ACCEPTING MANY TRADITIONAL AND ORIENTAL TECHNIQUES.

r21.exp: 'Do not ask you to IGNORE YOUR INTELLIGENCE and emotions, or ACCEPT DOCTRINES ON BLIND FAITH. (21)____.' → G: IN FACT, YOGA REQUIRES YOU TO APPLY YOUR INTELLIGENCE IN UNDERSTANDING ITS TECHNIQUES AND ACCEPT ITS TEACHINGS.

r22.exp: 'The word yoga means UNION. (22)____. During yoga, a person can DISENGAGE with the material world.' → B: THUS, BY PRACTISING YOGA, A PERSON IS SAID TO JOIN WITH THE SUPREME BEING.

r23.exp: 'Many people think yoga is ONLY about physical exercises. (23)____. Although the asanas have gained popularity, they are only the OUTER PARTS.' → F: BUT YOGA IS ABOUT MORE THAN JUST THE BODY, AND THESE PEOPLE GROSSLY MISUNDERSTAND ITS TRUE POWER.

r24.exp: 'Specialised branches concentrate on one aspect. (24)____. MANTRA YOGA is the repetition of chants.' → H: FOR EXAMPLE, HATHA YOGA FOCUSES ON POSTURES TO PURIFY THE BODY, GIVE BETTER CONTROL OVER THE BODY'S ORGANS, AND PROVIDE THE NECESSARY STRENGTH AND STAMINA FOR MEDITATION.

r25.exp: 'London cabs HAVE BEEN licensed since 1639' — present perfect za stanje koje traje od prošlosti do danas (since).

r26.exp: 'BEING out in all types of weather, poor conditions endangered...' — particip prezenta za uzročno-posljedičnu okolnost.

r27.exp: 'Sit on the box IN rain, snow, cold and wind' — prijedlog 'in' za vremenske uvjete (in the rain/snow).

r28.exp: 'Most cabbies WOULD have a lad employed' — 'would' za prošle navike/prošla tipična stanja.

r29.exp: 'Sent his manservant OUT into a raging blizzard' — frazalni glagol: send out = poslati van/napolje.

r30.exp: 'Why he HAD BEEN out so long' — past perfect u neupravnom govoru (radnja prethodila prošlom trenutku pitanja).

r31.exp: 'In no CONDITION to take him' — fiksna kolokacija: in no condition to = nije sposoban za (pijanstvo).

r32.exp: 'Came UP WITH the idea' — frazalni glagol: come up with = smisliti, doći na ideju.

r33.exp: 'It turns OUT that...' — fiksni izraz: it turns out = ispostavlja se.

r34.exp: 'IT is Queen Victoria who is credited with...' — cleft rečenica: it is + NP + who/that.

r35.exp: 'In ORDER to confuse the evil spirits' — fiksni izraz: in order to = da bi, kako bi.

r36.exp: 'Protected them FROM evil spirits' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: protect from = zaštititi od.

r37.exp: 'FOR the same reason' — prijedlog 'for' uz reason: for the same reason = iz istog razloga.

r38.exp: 'Something blue STANDS for purity, love, and fidelity' — frazalni glagol: stand for = simbolizirati, predstavljati.

r39.exp: 'A family member WOULD bring them a cup of honey wine' — 'would' za prošle navike (povijesna praksa).

r40.exp: 'One moon, WHICH is how the term honeymoon originated' — relativna zamjenica 'which' za nerestiktivnu relativnu rečenicu.
